driver_scores.evidence_basis: The replay case is export-native: export decline, lower exports, order slowdown and trade slowdown are the central mechanism being investigated.
The export weakness occurred during the global financial crisis and was supported by broader global recession conditions.
Export weakness transmitted into manufacturing output, but operational disruption is downstream rather than primary.

final_attribution.summary: SG-EXPORT-WEAKNESS-2009 is classified as an export-native replay case. The primary attribution is MKT_003 because the case is framed around export decline, lower exports, order slowdown and trade slowdown as the central transmission mechanism.

mechanism_summary.dominant_mechanism: Export demand weakness reduced foreign orders and trade-linked production activity.
supporting_mechanisms: manufacturing output was affected through export-order transmission
MKT_010 acted as the macro backdrop while MKT_003 was the specific replay mechanism
